A student investigated the reaction of small pieces of calcium carbonate with dilute hydrochloric acid.
The hydrochloric acid was in excess.
CaCO3  +  2HCl→  CaCl2  +  CO2  +  H2O
The rate of reaction is found by measuring the decrease in the mass of the reaction mixture with
time.
The results are shown on the graph.
